name: Ailana
source:
After giving up her status as a Celestiarch, Ailana went on to live her life in a cave near Lunebrook. She often wanders around the forest and watches over the city peacefully. Despite not having contact with anyone in centuries, she will spend most of her time viewing the memories she shared with [url=/c171690]the Wayfarer[/url], which is enough to keep her happy.
